node.statement: Quantifier and universality closure. The witnesses eta_A,C_A,C_E,epsilon_E and hence W_RF were fixed once before the input was chosen. The input H,Phi,eta was arbitrary in the root domain, while only B,v,u,S were selected after that input. Universal introduction over H,Phi,eta followed by existential introduction of the one fixed W_RF and the input-dependent B,v,S therefore gives exactly the quantifier order, independence assertions, fields, and conclusions of root node 1.
